tldr: Under a hard treatment cap on a known radius-\(r\) cycle, the best precision for the full-rollout causal contrast on the published endpoint infinity-moment ANI class is \(R_{\mathrm{end}}=R\sim(2r+1)/B\) whenever \((2r+1)/B\to0\) and \(B/n\to0\). Hence the growing-neighborhood constant under normalization \(B/r\) is two. A fixed-design erasure proof transfers the bounded-table converse to this endpoint-only bounded class, and observable center and shrinkage rules attain the constant using only endpoint-exposed outcomes. The finite sandwich and exact boundary \(R_{\mathrm{end}}=1\) if and only if \(B<2r+1\) hold on that same class. Restricting treatment to one contiguous bundle has asymptotic minimax risk \(1/4\), while unrestricted cap-supported risk tends to zero. The general finite-budget correction remains open beyond the proved shrinkage subregime.
gap: The closest unrestricted ANI minimax theory permits every Boolean assignment, and its exposure-merging argument need not respect a physical treatment cap \cite{KandirosHarshawSavje2026Minimax}. Sharp SUTVA theory supplies a useful decision-theoretic template but lacks overlapping neighborhoods \cite{SudijonoDobribanTchetgen2026Sharp}.
